prompts.travel: Create ONE refined cute cartoon female professional mascot concept. IMAGE 1 is ONLY the reference for attractive illustrated facial detail, hair drawing and chibi style; IMAGE 2 is ONLY reference for elegant white-collar clothing colors and accessories. Synthesize them into a new coherent FULLY CARTOON 2D character: about 3 heads tall, pleasantly rounded large head, small compact grown-up body, pretty almond-round expressive brown eyes with visible drawn pupils and delicate lashes, softly arched eyebrows, tiny simplified nose, small lively warm smile. Do NOT use black dot or giant oval button eyes. NO photoreal face, NO realistic human proportions, NO 3D. Charming sophisticated hand-painted anime/cartoon sticker with clean delicate outlines, soft pastel cel shading, airy highlights. Preserve long chestnut hair and neat soft straight bangs, individual illustrated strands but not photographic detail. Small pearl studs. Clothing entirely from image 2: light taupe tailored blazer with a fitted feminine shape, cream blouse, charcoal ankle trousers, small refined brown loafers, tiny understated wristwatch. Completely REMOVE every gaming/cyan/magenta/neon/patch/sneaker element from image 1. Pose: relaxed slight three-quarter standing, friendly head tilt, one arm hugs a slim cream folder, other hand carries a small caramel leather document tote at side; natural compact arms/legs, full figure visible. The goal is stylish cute young adult white-collar woman, polished mascot design rather than toddler, realistic fashion drawing, elementary flat icon or schoolgirl. Thin clean white/ivory sticker edge. Truly transparent background; no haze, glow, vignette, gradient, ground shadow, scene, text or watermark.
